text:
luis_support: Heads-up — Northbridge Health is blocking payment. Their procurement team will not accept any invoice unless it contains a customer PO number and exact legal entity + tax ID. They put account on hold. Ticket #123456.

mira_billing: Got it. We can reissue but need the PO value and legal name exactly as procurement provides. Also they require PO printed on PDF header.

alex_k: I pinged the account owner (sam_dev) earlier. Sam, did procurement send the PO or are they still requesting vendor docs?

sam_dev: They requested a vendor form + W-9 last night and said they'd issue PO after that. I asked them to upload to the shared folder — no PO yet. Customer said procurement meeting is tomorrow morning, trying to push.

finance_bot: Invoice 7890 status: on-hold (reason: missing customer PO).

luis_support: What specifically do we need to change to mark invoice acceptable? Metadata field only or need to rebuild PDF?

mira_billing: We'll need to add field "customer_po" in invoice metadata and regenerate PDF with PO printed top-right. Template supports this. Quick regen command (internal):

```bash
curl -X POST https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/7890/regenerate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $BILLING_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"customer_po":"PO-XXXX","legal_name":"Northbridge Health, Inc.","tax_id":"12-3456789"}'
```

mira_billing: If you can get PO value today we can reissue and send same day.

sam_dev: I'll ping procurement contact again and attach vendor form link. Can you hold off sending any dunning notices until EOD?

luis_support: Yes, please suspend payment reminders for this account until we confirm PO. I'll flag on the account.

alex_k: Note from procurement: they will only accept invoices with vendor name matching their vendor registry entry. Mira — can you confirm exact file output uses 'legal_name' verbatim?

mira_billing: Confirmed. PDF generation uses the legal_name field verbatim. Also legal asked that PDF include a small PO line under invoice header. I can include it in the template.

sam_dev: Procurement replied with PO: "NB-2026-7782" and confirmed legal name is "Northbridge Health, Inc." Sent W-9 earlier today.

mira_billing: Received PO. Regenerating invoice now and will mark invoice metadata.

mira_billing: Reissued INV-7890-PO (internal id 0007890). Updated metadata.customer_po = "NB-2026-7782" and attached regenerated PDF to the ticket.

finance_bot: Invoice INV-7890-PO status: sent to customer (method: email), payment terms: Net 30.

luis_support: Great — thanks everyone. Closing the hold. Sam, please confirm once procurement acknowledges receipt so we can watch for payment.

sam_dev: Will do, I'll follow up after their meeting. :thumbsup:
